title: Preserve request URLs when the generated server address changes
goal: Check generated server URLs with empty and non-empty PathBase, update exact fixtures, and verify the application's request composition before choosing an explicit compatibility transform.

selectionNotes: Only empty PathBase changes the generator's trailing-slash convention. Do not claim every client breaks: this original explicit HttpClient composition works on both versions. No third-party generated client is claimed to have been tested. OpenAPI operation paths normally begin with /, so naïve concatenation can duplicate a slash, while generic root-relative URI resolution can discard a deployment prefix. The optional transformer is narrowly for root URL spelling; it does not configure hosting, forwarded headers or routing.
